theorem lg_target (a b c : ℚ) (h₁ : a + b = 5) (h₂ : b + c = 7) (h₃ : a + c = 6) : a = 2 := by
  let sum_eq : a + b + c = 9 := by
    have h_sum : (a + b) + (b + c) + (a + c) = 5 + 7 + 6 := by
      rw [h₁, h₂, h₃]
      simp only [add_assoc, add_left_comm]
    rw [h_sum] at h_sum
    simp only [add_assoc] at h_sum
    exact h_sum

  have h_a : a = (a + b + c) - (b + c) := by
    rw [add_sub_add_right]
    exact add_right_cancel (a + b + c) (b + c) (a + b + c - (b + c)) (a + b + c - (b + c))

  have h_a_val : a = 9 - 7 := by
    rw [sum_eq, h₂]

  have h_a_val_eq_2 : 9 - 7 = 2 := by
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, add_eq_sub, neg_zero]

  exact h_a_val_eq_2
